title: Retire the FetchFailure re-export shim (OD-12)
body:
The code half of **OD-12**, whose plan revision landed with the owner's plan corrections.

`transcripts.py` re-exported `FetchFailure` in mypy's explicit `X as X` form, with a comment arguing that callers "reasonably reach for it here" because this module is where a failure is **constructed**.

OD-12 settled that. The type is the ledger's record, and the placement it papered over was circular in the direction that matters: **the ledger is what the transcript stage reports failures to.** Two blind authors agreed on the ledger's behaviour and disagreed on where its types live, and the orchestrator's shared contract assigned modules ad hoc to close the gap — which is the whole reason OD-12 exists.

One import moves: `tests/test_ledger.py` now takes it from `ledger.py`, where it has always been defined and is now the only place it can be reached.

1180 passing, unchanged — this removes an alias, not a behaviour.
